title: Lesson fact
description: One checkable fact a lesson block teaches, tied to the source page it came from. Stored in Firestore at orgs/{orgId}/courses/{courseId}/facts/{factId}.

statement.description: The fact as a full sentence, e.g. 'Customers can return most items for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.'

value.description: The specific part that could go stale, e.g. '30 days'.

keywords.description: Lowercase words a message about this fact would likely contain. Used by the phone's prefilter.
